headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 30, 2026**
article:
The White Sox secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Orioles, with Grant Taylor earning the win. The Pirates outscored the Phillies 11-7 in a thrilling matchup, led by Brandon Marsh's 2 home runs and 2 RBIs. The Tigers took down the Yankees 7-3, with Casey Mize pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 10.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several key players landing on the injured list. Anthony Bender, a right-handed pitcher for the Miami Marlins, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shin stress reaction. Jeremy Peña, shortstop for the Houston Astros, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left calf strain. Dane Myers, center fielder for the Cincinnati Reds, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left shoulder contusion.

Several trades and roster moves have been announced, with the Seattle Mariners acquiring first baseman Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The New York Mets traded left-handed pitcher David Peterson to the Chicago Cubs for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured an 8-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Grant Taylor earning the win.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 11-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, outscoring them 11-7. Brandon Marsh led the Phillies' offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Casey Mize earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs. Amed Rosario led the Tigers' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Francisco Lindor leading the offense. Lindor hit his third home run of the season, a fly ball to right field.

top_news.title: **Bender Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher Anthony Bender has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shin stress reaction.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners as part of a trade announced on June 29, 2026.
